locked_conventions.physical_interval: [-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with L=2*log(lambda), Lebesgue measure, and zero extension
locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension
locked_conventions.source_normalization: the source-limit normalization is retained; unit normalization is rejected
locked_conventions.target_schedule: N=ceil(lambda^2), d=2*N+1, retaining N+1 even and N odd dimensions
locked_conventions.prime_block_sign: minus, as in source equation (3.19), before any norm or absolute value
locked_conventions.mixed_bridge: the residue-plus-bridge source Gram and every signed, physical-Gram, and source-metric cross term are retained

locked_formulas.ground_prolate_integral: for the positive unit ground state y_0 on [-1,1], I_0>=sqrt(lambda)/(sqrt(3)/2+4*pi*lambda^2/sqrt(5))
locked_formulas.fourier_mobius_variation: for omega_k=2*pi*k/L and a_k=sqrt(omega_k^2+1/4), V_k<=lambda^2*(8*a_k+10+4*L)/sqrt(L); hence V_(lambda,X_N)<=lambda^2*sqrt(d/L)*B_(lambda,N), B_(lambda,N)=16*pi*N/L+4*L+14
locked_formulas.mixed_trace_and_floor: the displayed M gives tr(B^*(I-P_F)B)<=1/(16*lambda^2)<1/(8*lambda^2) and T*P_F*T^*>=9/(128*lambda^4)I; this is unsigned
locked_formulas.normalized_quotient: for A=W*D^(-1/2), A_0=A restricted to (ker A)^perp, G=A_0^*A_0, and U=A_0*G^(-1/2), U is unitary and G^(-1/2)*A_0^*B*A_0*G^(-1/2)=U^*B*U
locked_formulas.quotient_determinant: det(A_0^*(B-zI)A_0)/det(G)=det(B-zI); whole-target capture preserves spectrum and inertia
locked_formulas.source_metric_pencil: a source-metric comparison instead subtracts tau*W^*W+mu*D, including the nonzero residue-plus-bridge cross block; it is not the physical pencil
locked_formulas.high_tail_capture: for every fixed locked lambda, finite N, and finite R, T_N applied to the closed span of corrected even modes c_n with n>R is all of X_N
locked_formulas.adjoint_breakpoint_jets: at y_m=m/lambda, [K_k^(r)]_(y_m)=sqrt(lambda/L)*(-lambda)^r*m^(-r-1)*(1/2+i*omega_k)_r; the orders r=0,...,2N form a nonzero Vandermonde at the distinct Fourier nodes
locked_formulas.high_tail_defect_metric: for each locked lambda, an explicit R_0(lambda) can be chosen so that every finite high-only segment satisfies (1/4)*D_(R,M)<=H_(R,M)<=D_(R,M); no advance spanning terminal M(lambda,N,R) is supplied
locked_formulas.explicit_high_tail_defect_cutoff: R_0(lambda)=max(n_star-1,R_eta), R_eta=max(0,ceil((-3+sqrt(1+4*A_lambda))/2)), A_lambda=2*c^2*m_lambda^2/3, makes H_(R,M)>=(1/4)*D_(R,M) for all M>R>=R_0(lambda)
locked_formulas.high_tail_conditioning_obstruction: for d=2*N+1 the normalized binomial Fourier direction cancels every arithmetic-breakpoint jump through order 2*N-1, forcing the source-whitened high-tail coframe floor to be at most an explicit O(R^(-2*d+1)) quantity and every high-tail right inverse to grow at least on the R^(d-1/2) scale at fixed lambda,N
locked_formulas.odd_residual: tau=<p,A_lambda*p>/mu, R=A_lambda*p-tau*p, b=R/sqrt(mu), and R is nonzero by the inclusive prime-power jump
locked_formulas.odd_spectral_measure: for the probability spectral measure omega_p of A_lambda generated by p/sqrt(mu), nu_(lambda,beta)^infinity=integral(x-tau)^2*(x-beta)d omega_p(x)
locked_formulas.finite_odd_nu_transfer: at fixed lambda and beta, r_N tends to R in H^delta for some 0<delta<1/2 and nu_(beta,N)=mu_N^(-1)*c_(lambda,beta)[r_N,r_N] tends to nu_(lambda,beta)^infinity
locked_formulas.conditional_transverse_transfer: the conforming spaces G_N=P_N*H_minus intersect p^perp are nested and form-dense; their floors decrease to the unprojected transverse floor, and if that floor is positive then the finite inverse loads converge to the unprojected load
locked_formulas.jump_log_energy: for the localized jump profile, (K/log K)*sum_(K<|k|<=2K)log(|k|+2)*|F_k|^2 tends to L*J_(lambda,n)^2/(4*pi^2), so the jump-guaranteed positive logarithmic energy is asymptotic to a constant times log(K)/K and tends to zero
locked_formulas.odd_sign_obstruction: the same 1/k jump tail and positive logarithmic high operator permit either sign of nu; complete cyclic data can miss a negative reducing direction; fixed b and nu can have inverse loads on opposite sides of one pole surplus

claim_boundary.mixed_cost_result: an explicit a priori full-target terminal bound of order lambda^18/(log lambda)^3 with displayed constants; not a transition-scale or signed theorem
claim_boundary.quotient_result: whole-target capture is exactly unitarily equivalent to the complete physical signed operator; the high-only defect metric has an explicit lambda-dependent cutoff, but an exact worst Fourier direction forces dimension-dependent right-inverse blowup and no advance terminal label or sign follows
claim_boundary.odd_result: fixed-parameter nu, transverse floors, and inverse loads transfer from exact unprojected quantities; the jump supplies no sign, floor, load margin, or uniform cutoff
